title: Implement identity-continuity logic
description:
Create chatbot/soul/identity.py with identity-continuity logic that resists drift across long conversation horizons. Implement compute_identity_anchor(state: SoulState, personality: Personality) -> str. The function must produce a stable identity description string that does not drift as the conversation grows. Algorithm: if state.identity_anchor is already set and not empty, return it unchanged (anchor persistence). Otherwise, construct an anchor from personality.name, personality.description, personality.core_traits, and personality.tone — never from the conversation content itself. The anchor must be deterministic given the same personality and state inputs. Additionally implement update_identity_anchor(state: SoulState, personality: Personality, new_anchor: Optional[str] = None) -> SoulState that returns a new SoulState with identity_anchor updated. If new_anchor is None, compute it from personality. If state already has a non-empty anchor, leave it unchanged (no drift).

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- docs/operations.md
- chatbot/soul/state.py (created by task e.2)
- chatbot/soul/personality.py (created by task e.1)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/soul/identity.py exists and defines compute_identity_anchor and update_identity_anchor
compute_identity_anchor returns the existing anchor unchanged when state.identity_anchor is non-empty
compute_identity_anchor produces a deterministic string from Personality fields when anchor is empty
update_identity_anchor never overwrites an existing non-empty anchor (drift resistance)
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: use LLM calls or model-dependent logic for identity computation
leak conversation content into the identity anchor
